title: Explainer-video team config
description: Schema for explainer-video.yaml in a repository's convention home (default docs/conventions): the team layer of the explainer-video plugin's settings. Keys are read by /explainer-video:produce and listed in plugins/explainer-video/README.md, Configuration. Contract: docs/adr/0064-home-plugin-customization-in-docs-conventions-yaml.md.

verification.description: How much independent checking this plugin's skills run: off, light (the default: skip the verifier dispatch), standard (run it) or strict (also run the optional passes). Read from the default branch's committed copy only, so a branch cannot lower it. Levels: docs/contracts/verification-level/README.md.

verification_skills.description: Per-skill verification level, keyed by skill name (for example produce); an entry beats this file's verification value.

stitcher.description: The stills renderer's final encode: ffmpeg (the built-in reviewer-stills profile), or a command run without a shell, with {inputs} (stitch.json: frames with seconds, audio, captions) and {out} (the MP4) substituted. Read from the default branch's committed copy only, since it runs a command: a branch cannot change it.

frame_stylesheet.description: Repository-relative path of a CSS file replacing the stills renderer's bundled frame stylesheet. The file and its content are read from the default branch's committed copy only, so a branch cannot change them. The renderer sets the frame size and pads the bottom caption band (24%) itself; keep content out of that band: captions burn there and the quality check compares only the area above it.

upload_limit_mb.description: Upload limit in MB (10^6 bytes) for a stills video; over it the video splits at chapter starts, never recompressed or cut.
